Name: Malignant Creep
Description: LIVING GLOB OF TISSUE (Any Phase, passive) Creep Tumor tokens have STAY IN PLAY and DISPLACEMENT. CREEP REMOVAL (Any Phase, passive) If an Enemy Unit ends a Move, Deploy, Run, Charge or Disengage action Within 1" of a Friendly Creep Tumor token, remove that token from the battlefield. MALEVOLENT MATRIARCH (Assault Phase, passive) If the active Friendly Zerg Unit declares a Charge action while ON CREEP, it gains +1 Modifier to IMPACT Hit Rolls.

Name: Overlord
Description: BM: 1 VENTRAL SACS (Movement Phase, active) Set a Faction Indicator anywhere on the battlefield more than 10" away from any Enemy model. At the End of the Round, the controlling player may Deploy one Ground Unit from Reserves in base-to-base contact with this Faction Indicator. EXCRETE CREEP (Assault Phase, active) Set a Creep Tumor token on the battlefield Within 6" ( Line of Sight is not required) of either a Friendly Entry Edge or an existing Friendly Creep Tumor token.

Name: Overseer
Description: BM: 1 OVERSIGHT MODE (Movement Phase, active) Set a Faction Indicator anywhere on the battlefield. While Enemy Units are Within 6" of this Faction Indicator, they lose HIDDEN Status. PNEUMATIZED CARAPACE (Assault Phase, reaction) Use after a Friendly Unit rolls a D6 for Charge Distance. Roll an additional D6 and use the higher result to calculate the total Charge Distance.

Name: Reactive Creep
Description: LIVING GLOB OF TISSUE (Any Phase, passive) Creep Tumor tokens have STAY IN PLAY and DISPLACEMENT. CREEP REMOVAL (Any Phase, passive) If an Enemy Unit ends a Move, Deploy, Run, Charge or Disengage action Within 1" of a Friendly Creep Tumor token, remove that token from the battlefield. REACTIVE TISSUE (Any Phase, passive) While a Friendly Zerg Unit is ON CREEP, it gains DODGE (1) against any attacks targeting it.

Name: Roach Warren
Description: BM: 1 NASTY SURPRISE (Assault Phase, active) The active Ground Unit loses the Burrowed Status.

Name: Spawning Pool
Description: BM: 1 FERAL RAGE (Combat Phase, active) The active Unit’s first Close Combat Weapon used gains PRECISION (2).

Name: Spawning Pool (Six Pool)
Description: BM: 2 TIMING PUSH (Movement Phase, active) The active Zergling Unit Deploys from any table edge that is not a Player’s Entry Edge. This action must end more than 10" away from any Enemy model. FERAL RAGE (Combat Phase, active) The active Unit’s first Close Combat Weapon used gains PRECISION (2).

Name: Zagara's Swarm
Description: BM: 1 INSTINCTIVE REACTION (Any Phase, reaction) Use when an Enemy Unit declares a Close Combat Attack against a Friendly Unit. That Friendly Unit becomes eligible to make an Evade Roll against that attack. ZERG CREEP (Any Phase, passive) During Army Building, select exactly one Creep Card and add it to their Army List, paying its listed cost (if any). SCOURGE QUEEN (Combat Phase, active) If the active Unit contains more models than the combined number of models in all Engaged Enemy Units, its Close Combat Weapons gain INSTANT and PRECISION (4).

Name: Zerg Swarm
Description: BM: 1 BROOD INSTINCT (Any Phase, reaction) Use before a Friendly Unit makes an Evade Roll. Apply a +1 Modifier to that roll. ZERG CREEP (Any Phase, passive) During Army Building, select exactly one Creep Card and add it to their Army List, paying its listed cost (if any). RAPID BURROWING (Movement Phase, active) Select one Friendly, Unengaged Ground Zerg Unit on the battlefield. That Unit gains the Burrowed Status, even if it has already been Activated this Round.
